_provenance: Authoritative stimulus playlist for the current Unity clip-log format (single comma-delimited CSV per session folder; SourceType/SpeakerChannelIndex/SourcePosition*/ClipNumber/ClipRepetition/ClipName/ClipStart/ClipEnd -- see zyldoa/unity.py:parse_clip_log). Stimulus family (pink noise vs phonemes) is read from the session's CSV FILENAME, not any column or ClipNumber (which is reused 0-9 with different meaning per family), and mapped to these indices via zyldoa/unity.py:FAMILY_STIM_INDEX. The legacy 8-entry TrialDefGenerator.cs playlist (tones, phone ringing, applause, speech) was retired 2026-09-25 when the old TrialData/FrameData CSV parsing was removed. type drives the DOA analysis band (broadband_noise = 0.4-1.2 kHz); phonemes additionally get the adaptive early-window search (zyldoa/pipeline.py:ADAPTIVE_WIN_LABELS) since, like speech, they have a variable/intermittent envelope.
